points.why: It explicitly names Drift to Low Performance (eroding goals).
It describes B1 (fix performance, delayed by quarters) and B2 (lower the goal, one meeting) closing the same gap, with B2 winning because it is faster.
It re-anchors to customer expectations, competitors or the team's good year, and makes the target an explicit written decision with an owner and rationale.

pitfalls.why: It suspects a capacity gap but centres the diagnosis on the moving goal and calls target changes treating a symptom.
